title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: When dealing with matrices, it's important to remember that the dimensions are given as rows by columns. For example, a matrix with $$3$$ rows and $$2$$ columns is described as having dimensions $$3$$ by $$2$$.

title: Matrix Y in OLS
text: In the context of Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), the matrix Y represents the dependent variable, which is typically a column vector. Think about how many observations you have and how that relates to the number of rows in Y.

title: Matrix Y Dimensions
text: Consider the number of observations (n) you have. How does this relate to the number of rows in matrix Y?
